approach: Static recompilation of the original binary, presented by the RT64 renderer.
notes: Windows x64 and Linux x64 release packages are published and maintained; the port is pre-1.0 and under active development. Single-player races can be configured with 2 to 16 cars. Experimental code and texture packages use the shared mod manager; named game-data, lifecycle-event and object-extension APIs remain incomplete. Experimental, opt-in D3D12 ray-traced shadows accept all 24 car selections and all six circuits in one-player Time Trial, Arcade, Single Race and Championship; visual coverage remains pre-alpha. Experimental Android ARM64 APKs are published with device-specific limits; automatic resolution is capped at 2x on the tested Adreno 615 system driver, and other device/driver combinations need validation. There is no macOS support. Only the North American USA release is supported. The recorded SHA-1 is for the 4 MiB big-endian .z64 dump; a byte-swapped copy of the same cartridge hashes differently.
